name: Drag Racing Club
author: Addicting Games
description: What segment of a mile do you choose to live your life in?  A lot of people like to do a quarter mile at a time. That is fine. That is there choice. No one wants to take that away from them. But what if you wanna live your life a half mile at a time, or three-quarters of a mile at a time or really even a full mile? It should be your choice. You should be allowed to make that choice and we here at Addicting games support that choice. That is why we publish a game like Drag Racing Club. Drag Racing Club is a fast-paced side scrolling racer game where players compete to get the fastest time and beat their opponents.  You can upgrade your car you can collect power ups, you can cut the other drivers off. There are all sorts of little tactics you can pull in order to be number one. And we support all of these tactics. We support the liberation of the self through horsepower, raw speed, and pure power. If you think you're fast enough, smart enough or tough enough to jump into the driving seat of a game like this, we'd love to see you try. We encourage you to live your life as fast and as far as you want
